description: 后梳深发配浓密眉毛，厚实胡须勾勒粗犷的面部轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Graves is a broad adult man with swept dark hair, a heavy moustache and beard, thick eyebrows, and a weathered composed face. Preserve his rugged long coat, fur collar, fully covering shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and heavy boots. His distinctive large double-barreled firearm is carried low with the muzzle directed at empty ground, finger away from the trigger and no cigar or smoke.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: lilac pencil shadow brown, navy, fur ivory, copper sunset; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
